day_shape: 69 items dominated by a heavy Khamenei Unity Week message cycle and regime claims of $400m damage to US Bahrain base, alongside IDF strikes killing named Hamas Nukhba operatives in Gaza, an Isfahan court sentencing 10 protesters to death, and a UKMTO-reported projectile strike on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz; nothing from UK Parliament, OFAC or IAEA.

threads.label: Khamenei Unity Week message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published the full text and multiple excerpts of a Unity Week message calling US and Israeli leaders enemies of the entire Muslim ummah and urging Gulf rulers to recognise their 'real enemy'. Defa Press amplified the message, citing Sputnik and Lebanon's Al-Ahd coverage, and carried Amoli Larijani calling it a guarantor of national survival.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hamas operatives in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of Hamas Nukhba commander Abd al-Fattah Abu al-Eish, an October 7 infiltrator, in Jabalia, plus Yasser Abu al-Khair and Mohammed al-Din in Khan Younis, and Hassam Osama Hussein Nasir in Deir al-Balah. Times of Israel military correspondent Manni Fabian reported each strike, with the IDF framing the Nukhba killings as responses to systematic ceasefire violations.

threads.label: Regime damage claims and Hormuz tanker
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press amplified a Military Times report they said valued damage to the US Naval Support Activity Bahrain, including Fifth Fleet HQ, at around $400 million from Iran's opening strikes. IRIB separately cited UKMTO reporting that a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz was hit by an unidentified projectile.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and protest fallout
threads.summary: Iran International reported a Revolutionary Court in Isfahan sentenced 10 protesters to death and six others to up to 25 years, while the Jerusalem Post flagged the death sentence of 43-year-old beautician Leila Abolhasani over January protests. Iran International also identified a Syria-veteran IRGC figure as commander of the Shahriar crackdown, and the IRGC said it had dismantled an alleged Israel- and US-linked cell in Sistan and Baluchistan.

threads.label: US post-war deterrence commentary
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported the US Joint Chiefs jointly warned Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth that continuing the Iran war risks weakening capacity elsewhere. Defa Press circulated video of former national security adviser Susan Rice saying failure to achieve declared objectives has damaged US deterrence, and IRIB carried Tucker Carlson calling for Trump's removal over nuclear-use remarks.

threads.label: Iranian economic strain and sanctions effects
threads.summary: Iran International reported the arrest of an alleged intermediary accused of owing Iran's banks over €300 million in export foreign currency, and separately documented Iranians describing cancelled language tests and visa hurdles blocking study abroad after new US sanctions. It also covered ILNA reporting on children forced into hazardous kolbari smuggling on Iran's borders.

threads.label: Regional realignments around Iran's axis
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported UAE investment in Lebanon being framed as leverage to pull Beirut away from Iran and Hezbollah, and noted more than 60 countries, including Saudi Arabia and Iraq, attended the 63rd Damascus International Fair. Israel Police also charged two Israeli teenagers with spying for Iran.
